craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of marshalled examples — parity and fencing. Helpers picture by entering-as-other; saps simile kept. Rejected: (a) saps→juices → killed: saps is earthy. Read aloud: HELP-ers, EN-ter-ing AS-oth-ERS … LIKE-earth-AND-wa-ter-SAPS.

lines: Helpers, entering as others, reaching matter's shape —
picture effects indeed — like earth-and-water saps.
l4.sanskrit_cite: hetumantaḥpraviśyānye prāpyopādānarūpatām citrayanti hi kāryāṇi bhaumodakarasā iva

reads_against.argmap: How do helpers picture effects? → Helpers picture effects by entering-as-other and reaching material-form — like earth-juices.
c1_essence: Stock examples turned: eye-fitness shows the higher self; smoke-fire proves khadira-wood by mere knowing (vv10-11).
The hetu fenced, others sifting, the whole Lord-made; helpers' strange way opened, pictured, and bounded; fancied spread refused (vv12-18).
